summary: Per-frame post-update dispatcher: runs mode dispatch, clamps a camera-shake float, checks booted/kicked state, runs session-mode update, updates steering-wheel animation, conditionally dispatches a resource thunk when the scoring gate dword_8AB6E4 != 2, runs the post-frame sub-handler, then gates a position/speed overlay rendering path on the byte_7CE254 flag and session-state checks.

local_names.v3: selected overlay trigger value (dword_7CE244 / dword_7CE248 / dword_7CE240)

operations.description: ModeBasedDispatch() runs the mode-specific update dispatch.
FloatClampWithEventDispatch(&flt_5EA4E8) clamps the camera-shake multiplier stored in flt_5EA4E8.
YouHaveBeenBootedHandler(dword_7CD25C) checks whether the player was booted/kicked from the session.
SteeringWheelAnimation(&dword_7CE058) updates the steering-wheel animation state.
If dword_8AB6E4 != 2, call ThunkToFUN0045b840((int *)&dword_7CD204) to dispatch a resource load.
sub_49F870(this) runs the post-frame sub-handler on the object.
If byte_7CE254 is zero, evaluate the session-state overlay path; otherwise return early with v2 holding byte_7CE254.
If SessionStateCheckWrapper(dword_7CD25C) returns non-zero, continue to the UI overlay path.

Select the overlay trigger value v3: if ShortComputation_36e0(dword_7CD25C) is true use dword_7CE244; else if FloatComparisonAgainstThreshold(dword_7CD25C) is true use dword_7CE248; else if CollisionThresholdCheck(dword_7CD25C) is true use dword_7CE240, otherwise return v2.
If the selected trigger v3 is non-zero, run the overlay rendering block.
v6 = RandomColorGenerator(150994943, -1, 0.0) generates a color for the overlay.
PositionComputationWithAlignment(dword_5D6D60 - v5 - 4, v4 / 2 - v5 / 2, 1, 0) computes the overlay draw position.
TwoFieldSetterUpdate(v5, v5) sets two fields to the computed v5 size value.
LOBYTE(v2) = ConditionalCall(0) captures the final conditional-call result.
Return v2 (derived from byte_7CE254, SessionStateCheckWrapper, or ConditionalCall).
